articles.title: Purpose
paragraphs: This service lets you organize and join videoconferences.

articles.title: Use of the service
paragraphs: Users agree to use the service in compliance with the law and the rights of others, and not to share unlawful or harmful content.

articles.title: Authentication and organization
paragraphs: Some features require authentication. Organizers are responsible for the meetings they create and the people they invite.

articles.title: Recording and transcription
paragraphs: Organizers inform participants and obtain their consent before any recording or transcription of a meeting.

articles.title: Availability
paragraphs: The operator strives to keep the service available but cannot guarantee it. Interruptions may occur, in particular for maintenance.

articles.title: Contact
paragraphs: For any question about the service, contact its operator.
